product_brief: Managed implementation of NIST Post-Quantum algorithms (ML-KEM, ML-DSA, SLH-DSA) in C#.
pqc_capability_description: Managed implementation of NIST Post-Quantum algorithms in C#. Supports ML-KEM (FIPS 203), ML-DSA (FIPS 204), and SLH-DSA (FIPS 205). Provides APIs for key generation, signing/verification, and encapsulation/decapsulation. Supports pure and "pre-hash" modes for signatures. All ACVP test vectors pass for ML-DSA, SLH-DSA, and ML-KEM.

testing_&_validation_methods: All ACVP test vectors pass for ML-DSA, SLH-DSA, and ML-KEM.
